mediator.title: Connect to a mediator
mediator.lead: It will hold your messages while this device is offline.
mediator.same: You are already connected to this mediator.

blocked.one: You have {count} contact through your current mediator. Changing it from a link is not possible yet: their messages would stop arriving.
blocked.other: You have {count} contacts through your current mediator. Changing it from a link is not possible yet: their messages would stop arriving.

registry.signInLead: You sign in with a key this wallet keeps for this portal only.
registry.linkLead: Your account there will take this wallet as a way in.
registry.note: Accept only if you started this yourself on {portal}.

errors.registry_insecure: This registry is not reached securely.
errors.registry_unreachable: The registry cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.registry_expired: This request has expired. Ask for a new code.
errors.registry_refused: The registry did not accept the answer.
errors.registry_not_a_signer: This wallet is not one of those that may sign it.
errors.registry_not_the_holder: This application was started with another wallet.
errors.registry_nothing_to_present: This wallet holds no credentials yet.
errors.registry_issuer_unverified: The credential is not signed by a key its issuer's DID lists: it was not kept.

registry.signFirstLead: This creates its DID. The registry publishes it with your signature.
registry.signLead: The registry publishes this version of its DID document with your signature.
registry.notSigner: This wallet is not one of those that may sign it.
registry.endorseLead: Your organisation vouches for it for a year, with your signature.
registry.pairLead: Your application to {issuer} starts here. You appear under a key this wallet keeps for {issuer} only.
registry.presentLead: {issuer} asks to see credentials from this wallet. Only the details below are shared, each bound to the key you hold it with.
registry.nothingHeld: This wallet holds none of the credentials asked for: go back to the form and type your details instead.
registry.submitLead: This is everything you send to {issuer}. Signing it sends it, and {issuer} can check it came from you.
registry.issueLead: You sign it as the issuer: the holder who applied receives it with what it says below.
registry.statusLead: Verifiers read this list to know whether {identity}'s credentials still hold. You sign it as the issuer; it changes nothing else.
registry.statusChangeLead: Verifiers read this list to know whether {identity}'s credentials still hold. Signing it gives the credential below its new status.
registry.receiveLead: {issuer} issued the credential you applied for. It is kept in this wallet, bound to the key you applied with.
registry.someMissing: Some credentials the form needs are not in this wallet: type those details in the form.
registry.verifyLead: {verifier} asks to see credentials from this wallet. Only the details below are shared, each bound to the key you hold it with.
registry.verifyNote: Accept only if you are in front of {verifier} and expect it to ask.

messages.emptyHint: Invite somebody, or accept their invitation, with the + button.

backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: What your words do not bring back

notifications.title: When a message arrives
notifications.note: Shown while the wallet is not in front. The system keeps what it shows in its own history, outside the wallet.

security.title: Security
security.keptInKeystore: This application's private storage, sealed by this device's secure hardware
security.deviceLockValue: Face ID or the iPhone passcode
security.startHint: Opens minimised, and locked until you unlock it
security.startError: The system would not change that. Try again.

profile.title: Your name
profile.hint: What your contacts see you as. Each gets it only through the address they know you by.
profile.label: Name
profile.saved: Saved and sent to your contacts.

unreached.one: Saved. {count} contact could not be reached; they will get it with your next change.
unreached.other: Saved. {count} contacts could not be reached; they will get it with your next change.

mediator.title: Mediator
mediator.none: Not connected. A mediator holds your messages while this device is offline, and it is the address others reach you at. It cannot read them: they are encrypted to you.

credentials.none: No credentials yet. Apply for one from an Almena registry's catalogue of credentials.
credentials.unreadable: The credentials could not be read.
credentials.removeQuestion: Remove it for good? Nothing keeps a copy: only {issuer} can grant it again.
credentials.removeFailed: It could not be removed. Try again.

unchecked.unreachable: Not checked: the issuer cannot be reached
unchecked.untrusted: Not checked: its issuer's list could not be trusted
unchecked.signature: Not valid: its issuer's DID no longer lists the key that signed it

credentials.checkedOffline: As of {when}: the issuer cannot be reached now

notice.suspended: {issuer} has suspended this credential: verifiers refuse it for now, and this wallet does not offer it.
notice.revoked: {issuer} has revoked this credential: verifiers no longer accept it, and this wallet does not offer it.

backup.exportBody: One file with your contacts, conversations, credentials, name and picture, sealed so that only your words open it. Keep it wherever you like: without your words it is nothing to anybody.
backup.importBody: Adds what a backup of this identity holds to what this device has. Nothing here is changed or removed.
backup.imported: Restored: {contacts} contacts, {messages} messages and {credentials} credentials that were missing.

errors.backup_file: The file could not be saved or read there. Try another place.
errors.backup_not_this_identity: That file is not a backup of this identity.
errors.backup_storage: What this device holds could not be read or written.

welcome.tagline: Your identity and your conversations, held by you and nobody else.
welcome.createHint: A phrase only you hold, and an identity only you can use
welcome.signInHint: Bring an identity back from the words you wrote down

intro.other: These {count} words are the identity. Write them down, in this order, and keep them somewhere only you reach.

phrase.warning: Nobody can give them back to you. Whoever has them has the identity, and losing them loses it.

acknowledge.other: I have written the {count} words down and I have them with me

phrase.restarted: That was not the word asked for. These are new words: the old ones are gone, so write these down before going on.

confirm.title: Check what you wrote
confirm.intro: Pick the word that goes in each position, reading from the copy you keep.
confirm.question: Which word is number {position}?

warning.other: One wrong answer starts the whole thing again, with {count} new words to write down.

restore.title: Your phrase
restore.intro: Write your phrase in the order you wrote it down. Twelve words or twenty-four, whichever you have — and in whichever language you made it.

errors.identity_entropy_unavailable: This device would not supply the randomness a phrase is made from. Nothing has been created.
errors.identity_word_count: A phrase has twelve words or twenty-four.
errors.identity_checksum: Those words are not a phrase this wallet ever produced. Check the spelling and the order.
errors.identity_no_draft: There was no phrase to confirm. Start again.
errors.identity_unknown: The identity could not be made. Try again.

protect.title: Choose a PIN
protect.intro: The identity is written down on this device now, encrypted, and these digits are what open it. There is nothing that can reset them: forgetting the PIN means starting again from your phrase.

pin.chooseSubtitle: {digits} digits, and this device is the only one that will ever check them.
pin.repeatSubtitle: So a slip does not become a lock nobody can open.
pin.callSubtitle: Somebody is calling. Unlock the wallet to answer.
pin.mismatch: Those two do not match. Start again.

attemptsLeft.one: {count} attempt left. When it is gone the identity is removed from this device, and your phrase is the way back.
attemptsLeft.other: {count} attempts left. When they are gone the identity is removed from this device, and your phrase is the way back.

pin.currentSubtitle: Asked for first, so nobody who finds the wallet open can replace it.
pin.replaceIntro: The identity itself is untouched. Only the digits that open it change.
pin.armSubtitle: Your PIN, once, and this device is given a key of its own.

errors.vault_destroyed: That was the last attempt. The identity has been removed from this device, and your phrase is the way back.
errors.vault_nothing: There is no identity on this device.
errors.vault_exists: This device is already holding an identity.
errors.vault_pin_length: A PIN is four or six digits.
errors.vault_pin_not_digits: A PIN is digits and nothing else.
errors.vault_no_identity: There is no identity open to write down.
errors.vault_unreadable: What is on this device is not something this wallet can read.
errors.vault_too_new: This was written by a newer version of the wallet. Update it, and the identity will be here.
errors.vault_storage: The identity could not be read from this device. Nothing has been changed.
errors.vault_entropy: This device would not supply the randomness the encryption needs. Nothing has been written.
errors.vault_unknown: That did not work. Try again.
errors.vault_no_device_key: This device is not holding a key. Use your PIN.
errors.vault_device_unproven: This device did not recognise you, so nothing has been turned on. Try again, or carry on with your PIN.
errors.vault_no_device_store: This device cannot keep a key of its own, so the PIN is the way in.
errors.vault_device_refused: This device did not recognise you. Try again.
errors.vault_no_pin: This wallet opens with the device's own lock, not a PIN.
errors.vault_no_passcode: This iPhone has no passcode, so the wallet needs a PIN of its own.

problem.title: This device is holding an identity it cannot open
problem.body: Nothing has been lost and nothing has been changed. Until this is answered the wallet will not offer to create a second identity over the one already here.

deviceLock.title: Locked
deviceLock.subtitle: Opens with Face ID or your iPhone passcode.
deviceLock.keyGone: This iPhone no longer holds the key: it goes when the passcode is turned off. Sign out and come back with your phrase.

logout.title: Sign out
logout.intro: Read this before you do. There is no support line that can undo it.
logout.identity: The identity goes. This device is holding it and nothing else is: not the wallet’s makers, not the mediator, not a backup somewhere.
logout.messages: Your conversations go with it. They were encrypted to this identity, and nothing without it can read them.
logout.phrase: Your phrase is the only way back. With it the identity comes back exactly as it was, on this device or any other. Without it it is gone, and gone is permanent.
logout.question: Do you have your phrase in front of you?
logout.waiting: You can sign out in {seconds} s

mediator.title: Connect to a mediator
mediator.intro: Paste the invitation link a mediator shows, or its address. The one below is Almena's own.
mediator.label: Invitation link or address

errors.messaging_locked: The wallet is locked. Unlock it and try again.
errors.messaging_invitation_unreadable: That is not a mediator's invitation link, address or DID.
errors.messaging_insecure: That mediator does not use HTTPS, so this wallet will not talk to it.
errors.messaging_mediator_unreachable: The mediator could not be reached. Check the connection and the address, and try again.
errors.messaging_mediator_refused: The mediator turned the request down.
errors.messaging_not_connected: This wallet is not connected to a mediator.
errors.messaging_keys: The keys for talking to the mediator could not be used.
errors.messaging_unreadable: What this device holds about the mediator could not be read.
errors.messaging_storage: The mediator could not be written down on this device.
errors.messaging_entropy: This device would not supply the randomness the encryption needs. Nothing has been written.
errors.messaging_unknown: That did not work. Try again.
errors.messaging_invitation_own: That is your own invitation. Send it to somebody else.
errors.messaging_counterparty_unreachable: The other person could not be reached. Try again later.
errors.messaging_pending: They have not answered your invitation yet. You can write once they do.
errors.messaging_contact_unknown: That contact is not on this device.
errors.messaging_message_invalid: A message cannot be empty or longer than 4,000 characters.
errors.messaging_photo_invalid: That picture is not one this wallet can keep. Try another one.
errors.messaging_calls_unavailable: Your mediator does not relay calls, so none can be made.
